updates.title: New Built-in Entra Role: SOC Identity Responder
updates.summary: Microsoft introduced the SOC Identity Responder role to enable security operations teams to execute identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring high-privilege roles. This least-privilege approach reduces response delays and improves security posture by limiting administrative capabilities to only what SOC teams need for incident response.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Entra Backup and Recovery is a built-in automatic solution that protects critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, and Conditional Access policies from accidental or malicious changes. This feature is enabled by default and allows admins to restore their tenant to a previous state when needed.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts (Preview)
updates.summary: Conditional Access now enables administrators to apply policies specifically to AI agent user accounts using Custom Security Attributes and agent-specific risk signals. This allows organizations to enforce compliance and risk-based controls on AI agents operating within their environment.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62825: Azure Key Vault Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Azure Key Vault could allow unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Admins should patch immediately to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic keys and secrets.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56163: Azure Kubernetes Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. This vulnerability could enable attackers to gain elevated access within AKS clusters.

updates.title: CVE-2026-56191: Exchange Online Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass in Exchange Online enables unauthorized attackers to tamper with email data over a network. Organizations should apply patches to prevent unauthorized modification of mailbox contents.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62835: Online Services Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authorization in Microsoft Online Services allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. This could expose confidential organizational data to unauthenticated users.

updates.title: General Availability: External Users Can Be Directly Assigned to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users not yet in the directory to access packages using their email address. These external users are invited as guests and are governed through Entra ID Governance, streamlining the onboarding process.

updates.title: General Availability: Improved Kerberos Key Rotation for Incoming Trust Referrals
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Kerberos key rotation now improves reliability for environments using incoming trust referral flows by validating decryption with both primary and secondary keys. This reduces authentication failures during key rotation cycles.

updates.title: General Availability: BYOD Support for Windows Client Using Entra Registration
updates.summary: Windows BYOD support using Entra-registered devices is now generally available, allowing users and partners to access corporate resources from personal devices. Administrators can assign the Private Application traffic profile to enable this capability without requiring compliance prerequisites.

updates.title: General Availability: Jailbreak/Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator App
updates.summary: The Authenticator app now detects and blocks jailbroken or rooted devices from adding or using work/school accounts, enforcing device compliance by default. Users on non-compliant devices must migrate to compliant devices to continue using organizational accounts.

updates.title: General Availability: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Domainless SAML federation allows external users to authenticate using their IdP-managed credentials regardless of email domain, eliminating the need for domain matching during sign-in or invitation. This simplifies B2B authentication for organizations with diverse email domains.

updates.title: General Availability: SCIM 2.0 APIs for Microsoft Entra ID in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs are now available in the US Gov cloud, providing government organizations with standards-based user and group provisioning capabilities. This enables developers and partners to build compliant identity lifecycle management solutions for sovereign cloud deployments.

updates.title: Public Preview: AD Group Enforcement to Prevent Unauthorized Changes
updates.summary: Entra Cloud Sync now enables enforcement of specific Active Directory groups so modifications can only occur through the provisioning service, blocking out-of-band changes. This prevents group drift and maintains consistency between on-premises AD and Entra.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Query Endpoint DLP Device Data via Advanced Hunting
updates.summary: Administrators can now query Endpoint DLP device configuration and policy sync attributes at scale through Advanced Hunting in the Defender portal using the DeviceInfo table. This enables centralized reporting on endpoint DLP status instead of manual exports.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Device Scoping Using Dynamic Device Groups
updates.summary: DLP policies can now scope to specific device groups defined in Entra ID, enabling conditional enforcement based on device type and user role. For example, organizations can enforce stricter policies on Windows devices while allowing macOS devices different protections.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Restrict External Email Processing in Microsoft 365 Copilot (In Development)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is being expanded to prevent Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external senders in real-time. This mitigates data risks from prompt injection and uncontrolled use of external email content as AI grounding data.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Safeguard Sensitive Data from External Web Search in Copilot (In Development)
updates.summary: DLP for Copilot and Copilot Chat is expanding to prevent sensitive data from being used in external web searches. This real-time control helps organizations prevent data leakage and oversharing through AI-powered search features.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive (Rolling Out)
updates.summary: A new File Quarantine action in DLP policies for SharePoint and OneDrive automatically moves flagged files to a restricted admin-controlled location, instantly removing user access. This provides rapid containment of sensitive data exposure while preserving content for investigation.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Extension to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (In Development)
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft cloud applications including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This expands data protection governance beyond the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
